svg.title: Serpent Scout - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: High Guard Update 2022, printed 165-166, PDF 166-167. Primary deck complete external envelope retains rounded nose, long narrow central hull, broad swept aft wings, tapered rear machinery and drive end. Smaller upper deck fits within aft central body; placement inferred from illustration and shared grid. Illustration corroborates wings and raised dorsal fin; vertical fin adds no invented lateral span. Room borders and detached turret excluded.
